title: Percolation threshold of the square-sum graph
plain: Keep each edge of the square-sum graph with probability p. Find the exact threshold for a giant component as N grows.
math: For bond percolation on $S_N$ with $p=c/\sqrt N$, determine $c^*$ such that a component of size $\Theta(N)$ appears w.h.p. iff $c>c^*$.
